description: Animates a still image into a short video clip from a start frame (Runway Gen 3a Turbo).

prompt.description: Text prompt for the generation. node.py:151-155 widget; validate_string(min_length=1) at execute.

aspect_ratio.description: The resolution (aspect ratio) of the output video.

duration.description: Number of seconds of duration for the output video.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).
